data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis: missing_error_path): Fail-closed BLOCK synthesis must be tightened: (1) try/except catches ONLY dispatch transport/LLM errors (subprocess.CalledProcessError, anthropic API errors, JSON parse errors) — NOT bare Exception (would mask downstream bugs as fake BLOCKs); (2) synthesized BLOCK rulings preserve original finding_hash and severity from input finding so the pre-commit gate's diff-hash check still works; (3) empty findings + dispatch failure → return empty rulings array (no-op, not synthesized BLOCK); (4) emit structured stderr log 'arbiter_dispatch_failed reason=<exception_class> finding_count=<n>' for observability.
